name: Hibikiya Ranmaru
source: Ranmaru has been sickly for a long time and had to be home-schooled. Recently his health has improved, and as an experiment his uncle - the Dean of Asao Private School - allows him to attend his school and live in dorms. There is just one catch - Ranmaru has to spy on his fellow students and report their transgressions to the Dean.
translation: Ranmaru has been sickly for a long time and had to be home-schooled.
